summary.text: Mark Huizenga is a Republican state senator from Michigan State Senate District 30 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 74 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2019 to 2021 and served as mayor of Walker.

paragraphs.text: Mark Huizenga was born in and lives in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Calvin University in 1990 and a master's degree in management from Aquinas College in 1996.
His career experience includes owning a consulting firm and holding senior management roles with health care organizations.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was formerly director of pediatric practices for Helen DeVos Children's Hospital and has served as an adjunct instructor at Grand Valley State University.
Huizenga was elected a city commissioner in Walker in 2011 and served as the city's mayor from 2013 to 2018.
He served in the Michigan House from 2019 to 2021.
In the Senate, his 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Appropriations Committee, the Finance Committee, where he is minority vice chair, and the Health Policy and Human Services Committee.
In his 2026 survey, he listed lowering costs and supporting public health among his key messages and said he voted against more than 30 tax and fee increases.
